These comments have already stopped being served: the runtime marked them
deleted the moment the `Delete` arrived, which is what ActivityPub asks of us
(§7.4) and is where the obligation is actually met.

What the runtime cannot reach is git. This removes the content there and keeps
the record — who wrote it, when, and when they took it back.

History still holds the original, and that is not the promise being made. The
promise was never that it did not exist; it is that the record says it was
withdrawn, and the commit is that record.

Merging is your call.
